raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner initially misattributed “The Bacchanal of the Andrians” to Nicolas Poussin (who died in Rome), instead of Titian (who died in Venice). This conflation set the investigation on the wrong “place” (Rome rather than Venice) and led subsequent steps to pursue why Roncalli left Rome, instead of the correct context—Roncalli left Venice for the conclave in Rome. The Planner later doubled down by mixing Titian’s dates/location with Poussin’s name, reinforcing the misdirection.
